svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Two measurements under the same one-second poll. Top: a room temperature that changes four times in two minutes. Of 120 reads, only 4 return a new value. Bottom: a motor speed updated every 5 milliseconds over one second. A one-second poll samples it once, so 199 of 200 updates never reach the application.

svg.text: One polling interval, two very different measurements
